title: SaaS Subscriptions & Renewals Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event) OR (index=personal sourcetype=rocketmoney:subscription)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="calendar:event","primary",sourcetype="rocketmoney:subscription","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from calendar:event and rocketmoney:subscription to see whether two saas subscriptions feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `calendar:event` and `rocketmoney:subscription` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main saas subscriptions data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
